title: Core generic primary filtration and finite etale cover
statement: The structural filtration and compatible finite etale generic cover exist with all conclusions of lem-sc-generic-primary-coarse-filtration-data except the ell-power annihilator clause.

proof.text: Set K=k(C), Omega=AlgebraicClosure K and Ks=separableClosure K Omega. Apply the abelian sheaf/Galois-module equivalence. Its additive stalk comparison transfers finiteness and the ell-primary condition to R=E(M).

Apply the Sylow module filtration to R to obtain an open subgroup H of index coprime to ell and the supplied finite invariant additive-subgroup chain with zero and full endpoints and ell-torsion trivial successor quotients.

Take the actual fixed field L=(Ks)^H. The open-subgroup fixed-field theorem supplies finite dimensionality, separability and equality of its fixing subgroup with H. Apply the stated normalization model hypothesis to L to obtain D=C.normalizationIn L, pi, and its compatible generic-point isomorphism e. The normalization is integral.

Apply the chain-to-sheaf transport theorem with R, its canonical action-on-germs comparison, H, n, A and e. This gives the zero-starting sheaf chain, short exact constant-biproduct quotients and terminal inverse-image identification; no new subgroup or normalization is chosen by that theorem.

Define q=e.inv followed by Spec(algebraMap K L). The normalization factorization and the given equation for e show q followed by the generic point of C equals the generic point of D followed by pi. Finite separability makes Spec L -> Spec K finite etale (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff), and these properties survive precomposition by e.inv. Build the finite-locally-free structure from finite, flat and locally-of-finite-presentation instances. Its fibre degree is Module.finrank K L by fiberDegree_comp_left_of_isIso, fiberDegree_eq_finrankGamma and finrankGamma_SpecMap. IntermediateField.finrank_eq_fixingSubgroup_index and the fixed-subgroup equality identify this degree with H.index, hence it is coprime to ell. Assemble the existential witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Lean decomposition of generic filtration: stalk, Sylow chain, fixed field, normalization and degree proved; chain-to-sheaf transport isolated

theorem exists_generic_primary_coarse_filtration_core
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C] [IsIntegral C]
    (hmodel : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra C.functionField L]
      [FiniteDimensional C.functionField L],
      IsFinite (C.fromNormalizationIn L) ∧ IsAffine (C.normalizationIn L) ∧
        IsConnectedCurve (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        Smooth (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        ∃ e : Spec (.of L) ≅ Spec (C.normalizationIn L).functionField,
          e.hom ≫ (C.normalizationIn L).fromSpecFunctionField =
            (C.fromSpecOfAlgebraFunctionField L).toNormalization)
    (M : Sheaf (Spec C.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (hfinite : Finite (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M))
    (hprimary : IsPGroup ℓ (Multiplicative (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M))) :
    ∃ (D : Scheme.{u}) (π : D ⟶ C), IsFinite π ∧
      IsConnectedCurve (π ≫ f) ∧ Smooth (π ≫ f) ∧ IsAffine D ∧
      ∃ hIntegral : IsIntegral D,
      letI : IsIntegral D := hIntegral;
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Sheaf (Spec D.functionField).smallEtaleTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
        IsZero (F 0) ∧
        (∀ (a : ℕ), a < n →
          ∃ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Spec D.functionField).smallEtaleTopology
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (d : ℕ),
            S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ F a) ∧
              Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ F (a + 1)) ∧
              Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ Nat.rec (0 : _)
                (fun _ A ↦ A ⊞ (Spec D.functionField).constantZMod ℓ) d)) ∧
        ∃ (q : Spec D.functionField ⟶ Spec C.functionField),
          q ≫ C.fromSpecFunctionField = D.fromSpecFunctionField ≫ π ∧
          Etale q ∧
          ∃ (d : ℕ), q.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree d ∧ d.Coprime ℓ ∧
          Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} q).obj M ≅ F n)
